description: Consume the mastery-advantage Math Graph: take the first release of the merged math.us-hs graph (one graph file and one many-to-one mapping file) from the hand-off folder into apps/math after the SHA-256 check and the validation, switch the app to the released graph, show the CCSS tags of the release in teacher reporting (primary first, PM-approved AP exception list, CCSS notice, no College Board text), and remove the 47 old graph data files, the graph-data scripts, and cross-course-equivalence.ts. Depends on kst-v32-runtime_20261114 and the first release.

sprint.goal: The math app reads its skill graph only from the released math.us-hs file, and the repository holds no graph data file that the release replaces.

stories.title: The app reads the released graph
